summary: Tested public portfolio APIs, authenticated CRUD, logout protection, and core responsive UI flows. Backend end-to-end CRUD passed; browser public category/design flow passed. Admin browser flow did not reach a stable visible dashboard in the final run.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid=brand-logo is duplicated on header and footer, violating unique critical element test IDs and causing strict locator failures.

integration_issues.issue: Final browser run did not observe add-portfolio-button after navigating to /admin; page remained in opening-desk/loading state or dashboard visibility assertion failed. Needs reproduction and investigation in browser logs.

action_items: Make all data-testid values unique, especially header/footer brand-logo.
Reproduce admin login in a clean browser and inspect why /admin can remain on opening-desk instead of rendering the dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin component has a race-prone nested load call inside the auth/me effect and redirects on any admin portfolio request failure; separate auth and portfolio loading/error states to make failures diagnosable.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one TEST_Social Media design through the authenticated API; no persistent test data remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public API/categories/portfolio, unauthenticated admin rejection, login cookies, authenticated create/update/delete, public persistence, logout, category tabs, and design empty state were tested. Admin browser dashboard stability and full UI add/edit/delete remain to retest.
rca of the issue: The strict locator failure is directly caused by Logo rendering the same data-testid in both Header and Footer. The admin browser finding was observed after successful public flow but without enough evidence to claim a backend failure; inspect browser network/console and admin loading state before changing business logic.
